name: meto
description: Guards and views for meto projects: overlap, domain, role and swarm-lead guards, model routing per slice, one report per agent, board pane, swarm band, slice IDs, handoff reminder

idPrefix.title: Slice ID prefix
idPrefix.description: Prefix /meto-slice uses for new IDs: slice gives slice-173, Lom_Slice gives Lom_Slice-0043. Set your own so two people never take the same ID.

leadEdits.title: Main-session edits in a swarm
leadEdits.description: In a swarm project, what happens when the main session edits a file inside an epic's domain: refuse sends the change to /meto-swarm, warn lets it through with a reminder, allow says nothing.

swarmBand.title: Swarm row above the prompt
swarmBand.description: Show each epic's status above the prompt. Off by default; /meto-board always shows it.
